items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Now I played with Simon Frazier too now, that's Saean's brother.

ctx.x: Oh he's old Dixieland, great piano. Now I played with Simon Frazier too now, that's Saean's brother. Yeah. Mitchell is the cousin and Simon is Saean's brother.
They weren't just one number man, they could play Dixieland? Dixieland.
